name: Cable TV
description: Builds cable-style channels from your libraries, collections, playlists, genres and decades on a deterministic schedule, publishes them to Live TV with a guide, and exposes a schedule API for clients that tune in instantly by direct-playing at the right offset.
overview: Scheduled, always-on channels built from your library

versions.changelog: Continuous Live TV stream that joins mid-show and runs through programmes (copy video, AAC audio, loudness levelling, one ffmpeg per watched channel). Commercial breaks with fill-to-grid and halfway or chapter mid-breaks. Round robin, block and marathon sorting, source weights, and a schedule preview on the settings page.
